tool_config.name: sohranit_semyu_careline_demo
tool_config.description: Saves a family's request for home care, before you offer assessment times. Call it exactly ONCE per call, only after the caller's name was spelled and confirmed and the phone confirmed — never with a placeholder name such as 'Caller', never for a message. Never put medical details, diagnoses or the care recipient's name here. If the result has ok false with kod net_imeni, nothing was saved: ask for the first and last name, spelled, then call it again with that name.

imya.description: Caller's first and last name exactly as spelled and confirmed, in Latin letters.

telefon.description: The confirmed phone number in E.164 format, e.g. +17185550142.

rayon.description: Neighborhood in Brooklyn or Queens where the person who needs care lives.

zip.description: Five-digit ZIP code where care is needed.

chasov_v_nedelyu.description: About how many hours of care a week the family wants; leave it out if they don't know.

oplata.description: How care would be paid: private, medicaid, ltc (long-term care insurance), unknown.

srochnost.description: How soon care is needed: srochno (within a few days), nedelya (within one or two weeks), pozzhe (later), ne_znayu.

sms_soglasie.description: true ONLY if the caller clearly said yes to text messages about the assessment (a confirmation and a reminder) in this call; otherwise false.

yazyk.description: Language of the conversation right now.
